text:
carla: quick question — we're about to rotate the KEK in AKV for the envelope flow. i want to run a lightweight cross-tenant probe first to validate managed identity unwrap from our dedicated tenant before the rollover. anyone done a dry-run for cross-tenant MI unwrap?
ben: not cross-tenant exactly. fyi RBAC vs access policies matters here — if the vault is using RBAC, the MI needs Key unwrap/unwrapKey permissions via AAD role. access policies won't apply across tenants. :thinking:
dave: +1. for cross-tenant the common pattern is: create a service principal in consumer tenant, add federated credential in provider AAD app, then grant that principal the 'Key Operator' role on the key. but watch tenant boundaries and consent.
amy: for the probe i'd do three things: 1) validate RBAC entry exists (az role assignment list) 2) test unwrap via a short script that calls AKV unwrap and checks HTTP 200 3) confirm diagnostic logs capture unwrap event to LA/workspace.
carla: can you paste the minimal az CLI snippet you use for the test?
dave: sure — here's a simplified check (pseudo):
```
# assume az login --identity or service principal is done in target tenant
az keyvault key unwrap --vault-name my-vault --name kek-key --algorithm RSA-OAEP --value "<wrapped-dek>"
# check exit code and audit logs in Log Analytics for OperationName: UnwrapKey
```
ben: minor note: CLI flags differ by extension/version; prefer using SDK callers for automation. also ensure Managed Identity token audience is https://vault.azure.net not graph.
amy: logging: make sure diagnostic setting includes "AzureDiagnostics" and streams to our Log Analytics workspace + Event Grid. we rely on OperationName & ResultType to detect unwrap attempts. example retention/alert rule: if ResultType != 0 and PrincipalName contains our MI -> fire.
carla: what about PIM/temporary elevation if we need to test unwrap in prod? we want minimal blast radius.
ben: use a short-lived role assignment via ARM template + automation account that deletes itself after probe. or use PIM just-in-time but that's slower. either way ensure audit link to JIRA ticket.
dave: rotation plan notes:
- pre-roll: run cross-tenant probe against canary vault
- step1: create new KEK (versioned key) with proper RBAC on new key
- step2: update wrapping service to use new KEK for new DEKs
- step3: rewrap DB/objects lazily + background rewrap job for cold objects
- step4: after sufficient coverage, deprecate old KEK version and monitor unwrap failure metrics for 48-72h

carla: sounds good. any gotchas with Azure Key Vault soft-delete / purge protection during rewrap?
amy: yes — if you delete keys accidentally, soft-delete keeps them but you still need purge protection if you want to prevent deletion. rewrap uses key versions, so avoid deleting the old KEK until you're sure. also check key usage flags (unwrap allowed).
ben: another gotcha: RBAC role binding can take up to a few minutes to propagate — include a short wait & re-check loop in probe.
carla: audit question — do we have existing log queries for UnwrapKey or do we need a new analytic rule?
dave: we have a basic kube/infra rule set but no robust UnwrapKey sentinel rule. i'll add one: KQL that looks at AzureDiagnostics | where OperationName == "UnwrapKey" | project TimeGenerated, ResultType, Actor = tostring(identity_claims_upn) etc. then tie to alert action group.
amy: also add a regression test to the infra repo: the probe script should return non-zero on failed unwrap and dump latest 5 LA records for correlation. store outputs to artifact bucket.
sec-bot: SECURITY NOTE: any cross-tenant MI flow must go through the security review checklist (jira SEC-2872). create ticket before running probe in prod. automatic approval required for KEK changes.
carla: ack. i'll open SEC ticket and attach the probe script. plan: run in canary vault tomorrow 09:30 PT, then small sample of prod objects during low traffic window.
ben: bring a rollback plan: how to switch back to old KEK (config flag) and a kill-switch to stop rewrap job.
dave: i can instrument metrics: unwrap_failure_rate, unwrap_latency by principal. i'll also add a dashboard tile in Console for the rollout.
amy: for long term: consider using hardware-protected keys (HSM) + customer-managed HSM for extra assurance and a rotation calendar.
carla: thanks all. I'll post the SEC ticket and the probe gist. tagging @sec-bot so we get checklist. :thumbsup:
